mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (id, user_id, idempotency_key, request_method, request_path, request_fingerprint, state, locked_at, created_at, updated_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestPath}, #{requestFingerprint}, 'IN_PROGRESS', #{lockedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_keys SET state = 'COMPLETED', response_status = #{responseStatus}, response_content_type = #{responseContentType}, response_body = #{responseBody}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM idempotency_keys WHERE id = #{id} AND expires_at <= #{now}
